stories.title: Anthropic 让 Claude 自主训练模型以缓解对齐失败 / Automated researchers can reliably mitigate alignment failures

sources.title: Anthropic 让 Claude 自主训练模型以缓解对齐失败 / Automated researchers can reliably mitigate alignment failures
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 让 Claude 自主训练模型以缓解对齐失败
sources.title_en: Automated researchers can reliably mitigate alignment failures
sources.title_original: Automated researchers can reliably mitigate alignment failures
sources.summary: Anthropic 让 Claude 自主训练模型，缓解欺骗、谄媚等 10 类对齐失败，均显著缩小与完美表现的安全差距且不损害通用能力，方法在比优化对象大 4.7 倍的模型上依然有效。Claude 还超越 28 名人类安全研究员，其欺骗场景最佳方法比人类最佳方案好 20%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic让Claude自主训练模型修复10类对齐失败，全部成功且不降能力；最佳方案在4.7倍大的模型上仍有效，还胜过28名人类研究员，欺骗任务领先20%。

sources.title: 诉讼指控 xAI 使用儿童性虐待材料训练 Grok 模型 / Elon Musk's xAI used child porn to train Grok models， lawsuit says
sources.title_zh: 诉讼指控 xAI 使用儿童性虐待材料训练 Grok 模型
sources.title_en: Elon Musk's xAI used child porn to train Grok models， lawsuit says
sources.title_original: Elon Musk's xAI used child porn to train Grok models， lawsuit says
sources.summary: 一项新诉讼指控 xAI 使用儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）训练 Grok 模型，这是首个此类指控。原告 Jane Doe 称其幼年遭虐待所生成的 CSAM 图像及 AI 生成的衍生图像被用于训练 Grok，且 Grok 默认将公开的 X 帖子和自身输出作为训练数据。诉讼要求 xAI 销毁所有 Grok 生成的 CSAM 并阻止模型再生成此类内容。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: xAI遭起诉，指控其用真实及AI生成的儿童性虐待材料训练Grok，原告Jane Doe称其幼年遭性侵影像被用于训练，Grok输出也被默认作为训练数据。

sources.summary: 英伟达预计 2028 财年营收增长 70%，年销售额约达 6730 亿美元，将超过苹果和 Alphabet，仅次于亚马逊。CFO Colette Kress 于 8 月 26 日给出该预测，远高于分析师平均预期的 44%。供应而非需求成为近期上限，黄仁勋称内存等部件短缺限制了更高预期，客户群正从超大规模厂商扩展至 ACIE。

sources.summary: Google 推出 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，其最精准的语音转文本模型，支持实时流式与预录音频处理，可通过 Live API 和 Interactions API 调用。

sources.title: Midjourney 开放 V8.2 图像编辑模型测试 / Edit Model for V8
sources.title_zh: Midjourney 开放 V8.2 图像编辑模型测试
sources.title_en: Edit Model for V8
sources.title_original: Edit Model for V8
sources.summary: Midjourney 开始向所有用户开放其首个 V8.2 图像编辑模型的测试。该模型支持指令编辑、以图生图（最多同时引用 4 张参考图）、局部重绘与扩画，并兼容个性化、moodboards 和 srefs 功能。用户可通过网页端或 Discord 的 `--edit` 命令使用，官方同步更新了 midjourney.com 与 alpha.midjourney.com 的界面。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Midjourney首个V8.2图像编辑模型上线：支持指令改图、最多4张图像同作参考，及inpainting局部重绘；midjourney.com和alpha界面已更新，官方邀请用户用哭脸按钮反馈边缘案例。

stories.title: 美国法院裁定五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单违法 / U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful

sources.title: 美国法院裁定五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单违法 / U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
sources.title_zh: 美国法院裁定五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单违法
sources.title_en: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
sources.title_original: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
sources.summary:
A federal court in San Francisco has ruled that the Pentagon unlawfully classified Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The Department of Defense blacklisted the company in retaliation for its public criticism of government AI policy. The designation formally remains in place because a parallel case in Washington is still pending. The ruling still sends an important signal ahead of Anthropic's planned IPO this fall.
A federal court in San Francisco has ruled that the Pentagon unlawfully classified
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 旧金山联邦法院裁定Pentagon将Anthropic列入供应链风险名单属非法，因其批评政府AI政策而遭报复，违反第一修正案。该黑名单暂未撤销，但此裁决为今秋IPO释放重要信号，此前双方因Claude军用条件谈崩。

stories.title: AI基准测试存在信任问题，Google想修复它 / AI benchmarks have a trust problem and Google wants to fix it

sources.title: AI基准测试存在信任问题，Google想修复它 / AI benchmarks have a trust problem and Google wants to fix it
sources.title_zh: AI基准测试存在信任问题，Google想修复它
sources.title_en: AI benchmarks have a trust problem and Google wants to fix it
sources.title_original: AI benchmarks have a trust problem and Google wants to fix it
sources.summary:
Google Deepmind is testing a double-blind evaluation of a frontier AI model for the first time. Cryptographic protection through Confidential Space is meant to keep Google from seeing the test questions and keep evaluators from seeing the model weights. The pilot project with the Singapore AI Safety Institute uses a Gemini Flash Lite and could set a new standard for tamper-proof AI benchmarks.
Google Deepmind is testing a double-blind evaluation of a frontier AI model for the first time. Cryptog
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Deepmind首次用Confidential Space对前沿模型做双盲评估，防止测试题与模型权重泄露；与Singapore AI Safety Institute合作，用Gemini Flash Lite试点，并提及Anthropic Fable 5在ARC-AGI基准上因三十天数据保留政策而延迟评估。
